## Scope
Build the test infrastructure for loading, validating, and working with attempt-resolution fixtures.

## Tasks
- Create test module in tests/attempts_mod.rs or similar
- Implement fixture loading functions for both formats
- Implement schema validation helpers
- Add binary version detection helpers

- Test module exists with appropriate functions
- Can load old-format fixtures and validate schema
- Can load new-format fixtures and validate schema
- Helper functions detect attempt-resolution support
- Helper functions probe binary capabilities
- Unit tests for loading/validation pass
- cargo fmt --check passes
- cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passes

Result: Independently verify completed documentation against actual results, clear instructions and the full requested outcome.

Starting condition: The author returned an exact candidate commit and two clean self-audit passes. Source-code acceptance remains valid unless text exposes a concrete contradiction.

Locations and inputs: /workspace/scratch/3160e3ba3d24/worktrees/scotty-completion/docs/backend-compatibility.md and README.md; app-handoff result, exact diff and relevant runtime/install/test/cleanup records under /workspace/scratch/3160e3ba3d24/coordination/results. Keep ID, timestamps, claims, recorded history and unrelated records intact. Use the accepted issue-editing-v1 contract in /workspace/scratch/3160e3ba3d24/worktrees/bead-completion/research/specs/issue-editing-v1.md. Windows production launchers must have one tray icon with Exit and stop only their own server processes.

Derive its installed basename as bead- plus the first12 hash characters plus .exe. Bind installer and configured-launch parameters from those measured values. Historical539cdd0/25a05bdfd8fe results remain historical. Preserve the exact reviewed parameterized installer and configured launcher, Next build and repaired tray module.

Steps:
1. Read the entire changed section and surrounding instructions. Compare each factual claim with actual full receipts and final source/runtime/binary IDs. Represent historical failures, retained limits, observed-but-lost logs and truly missing results accurately.
2. Check requested fields, dependency kind/direction, real Windows tray, selected default pin, local installation, remote publication, old-pin rollback, native history and cleanup instructions. App instructions must work without this conversation. Require README.md to present the supported tray-capable Windows production/source launch before npm run dev, which must be described as frontend development with its existing behavior. Match the repaired module identity and installed launch result; this writing change does not expand dev-server features.
3. Apply current language exclusions and verify all file/code/command literals. Separate useful suggestions from concrete missing/wrong information. Do not run product tests or invent additional user work.
4. Return pass, fail or pending with exact reviewed commit/file hashes and corrections. Preserve accepted unchanged text when a later result only needs a small factual update; review that update before final acceptance.

Required checks and completion: Pass requires accurate complete instructions and truthful completed/pending reports, including recovery and non-force cleanup. A bare status assertion without checking source records is insufficient.

Permissions and limits: Work in the cloud where possible. Root alone uses Emergency Maintenance on the PC and writes canonical task state. Keep the PC free for the user's Unreal/VR work: no PC builds, GPU use, visible browser or other UI control, service restarts, broad process termination, or changes to unrelated projects. Ordinary PC app runs are sequential, hidden, BelowNormal, with a 256 MiB Node heap and a 512 MiB total owned-process resident-memory cap. Read free RAM first and require at least 3 GiB before starting an app run; stop this task's processes if their memory cap is exceeded or foreground work shows resource pressure. The small helper diagnostic has its stricter 200 MiB total cap and 90-second maximum. Browser checks belong in the cloud. Preserve the existing PC native checkpoint and all Scotty machine-local task data. Do not initialize, replace, or upload the Scotty task store. Protect other workers' files. Reviewers inspect files and supplied results; they do not execute product tests or builds. On a new failed check, retain the exact error and stop the affected acceptance; send the concrete defect to root for a reviewed repair. Never repeat a mutation after a timeout until its result is reconciled. Do not obtain another process's claim credential.

Return /workspace/scratch/3160e3ba3d24/coordination/results/app-text-review.json with status, source_commits, binary_sha256 when relevant, checks and their exits, output_paths, changed_files, open_items, and git_result. State which requirement each check established and its limits. Mark lost earlier cloud output as unavailable; do not cite a deleted log as retained. Later work may proceed only after its listed prerequisites pass; a candidate record alone is not acceptance.

Git completion: Commit only this task's authorized repository changes. Before the checked installation, push backend changes to YossiMH/bead-rs task/bead-finish-20261124 and app changes to YossiMH/bead-me-up-scotty task/scotty-finish-20261124, keeping main at the installer's verified baseline. The recovered app working branch is task/scotty-recovered-20261124; use ordinary descendant publication to its named remote task branch. After installation, publish completed changes to main by ordinary fast-forward integration. Never force-push or include private local task data. Report the commit and verified remote ref. With no changes, check for this task's unpublished commits and otherwise report no changes; do not create an empty commit. If pushing fails, try another independently permitted Git route, record the failure and next permitted retry, and continue useful authorized work. A failed push alone does not prevent task closure or the next task.

Revision6 tray selection: Explain and verify the actual accepted two-module tray host and installed result. Direct detached PowerShell source38 failed before script entry and remains historical. ## Genesis Bead
Tied to plan: /home/coding/bead-rs/docs/plan/plan.md (revision 7, section 8)
Authorized by: docs/adr/004-raise-msrv-to-1.85-and-edition-2024.md

## Overview
Raise the MSRV from bootstrap-era Rust 1.75 to 1.85 with edition 2024, make the declared floor CI-enforced instead of aspirational, then refresh the drifted =-pinned dependencies against the verified baseline. Investigation of 2026-08-15 confirmed 1.75 still compiles (luck, not verification), all real builds already use current stable, and no MSRV lane exists.

## Progress
- [ ] Manifest flip: rust-version 1.85 + edition 2024 + doc updates
- [ ] CI: pinned MSRV verification lane in bead-rs-ci (declarative-config)
- [ ] Dependency refresh: rusqlite/clap/clap_mangen/time/tempfile/assert_cmd

Phase 2 (CI MSRV lane): beadrs-dd914e5b closed via declarative-config 3d7c8ba8/2823bbb9/feb47f54/ad8988d4 (all pushed; 0 unpushed commits touching the template). Verified the live in-cluster bead-rs-ci WorkflowTemplate carries the pinned MSRV=1.85 lane with the Cargo.toml rust-version drift guard; real run bead-rs-ci-msrv-manual-ks5f5 Succeeded per closure evidence.

Phase 3 (dependency refresh): beadrs-c0e4fb66 closed — manifest carries rusqlite 0.40.2, clap 4.6.6, clap_mangen 0.3.3, time >=0.3.45,<0.3.46, tempfile 3.27.0, assert_cmd 2.2.2 (+uuid 1.24.1, fs2 0.4.3) matching the ADR-004 refresh table; Cargo.lock tracked and committed with matching resolutions; 52 man pages regenerated; benchmark smoke budget preserved. Closure evidence: fmt/clippy/full tests/conformance/concurrency/man reproducibility all passed.

Independent recheck today: cargo +1.85 check --all-targets passes clean locally in 20.68s. Genesis checklist items are all satisfiable only via description (not editable post-create); this note is the completion record.
